name: DAST Rule Set
author: Nilanjan Chowdhury
description: Enterprise DAST rules for web application security testing — 22 vulnerability detection modules with PoC generation

rules.name: SQL Injection Detection
rules.description: Detects SQL injection vulnerabilities by injecting payloads that attempt to manipulate SQL queries.

rules.name: Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) Detection
rules.description: Detects reflected and stored XSS vulnerabilities by injecting script payloads.

rules.name: Server-Side Request Forgery (SSRF) Detection
rules.description: Detects SSRF vulnerabilities by attempting to access internal resources.

rules.name: Path Traversal Detection
rules.description: Detects path traversal vulnerabilities by attempting to access sensitive files.

rules.name: Command Injection Detection
rules.description: Detects OS command injection vulnerabilities by injecting system commands.

rules.name: XXE (XML External Entity) Detection
rules.description: Detects XML External Entity injection vulnerabilities.

rules.name: CSRF (Cross-Site Request Forgery) Detection
rules.description: Detects missing or weak CSRF tokens in sensitive requests.

missing_token.check: No CSRF token found in form or request

rules.name: JWT Weakness Detection
rules.description: Detects weak or misconfigured JWT implementations.

rules.name: Open Redirect Detection
rules.description: Detects open redirect vulnerabilities.

rules.name: IDOR (Insecure Direct Object Reference) Detection
rules.description: Detects IDOR vulnerabilities by changing object references.

rules.name: LDAP Injection Detection
rules.description: Detects LDAP injection vulnerabilities.

rules.name: XPATH Injection Detection
rules.description: Detects XPATH injection vulnerabilities.

rules.name: Host Header Injection Detection
rules.description: Detects Host header injection vulnerabilities.

rules.name: NoSQL Injection Detection
rules.description: Detects NoSQL injection vulnerabilities in MongoDB, Cassandra, etc.

rules.name: Unrestricted File Upload Detection
rules.description: Detects unrestricted file upload vulnerabilities.

rules.name: Server-Side Template Injection (SSTI)
rules.description: Detects SSTI vulnerabilities in template engines.

rules.name: HTTP Request Smuggling Detection
rules.description: Detects HTTP request smuggling vulnerabilities.

poc_template.code:
import requests

# HTTP Request Smuggling PoC requires raw HTTP request crafting
# Use this script as a template to craft CL.TE/TE.CL requests
print("[!] Request Smuggling detected — manual PoC required.")

rules.name: CORS Misconfiguration Detection
rules.description: Detects CORS misconfigurations allowing unauthorized domains.

rules.name: Race Condition Detection
rules.description: Detects race condition vulnerabilities.

rules.name: GraphQL Injection Detection
rules.description: Detects GraphQL injection vulnerabilities.

rules.name: Log4j (CVE-2021-44228) Detection
rules.description: Detects Log4j JNDI injection vulnerability.

rules.name: Sensitive Data Exposure Detection
rules.description: Detects exposure of sensitive data in responses.
